data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independent of others: an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Other catches need recalculation. Intentions aren't enforceable; this risks future income and isn't guaranteed to maximize long-run returns.
